outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs of PA time-lapse images, not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows normalized intensity data plotted as scatter points/time-series curves with fitted diffusion models (line/scatter plot type), and the insets similarly show data points over time with error bars. Line/scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement, so this passes regardless of the averaging shown in the insets.
